title: Preallocate WAL segment path strings
description: Replace WAL segment path and segment scan-prefix format! calls with exact-capacity helpers.

criteria: Segment 0 path remains the base WAL path

notes: Segment path construction reserves base length, .seg. separator length, and decimal segment id length.
The segment scan prefix helper preserves the exact filename prefix used by find_segments.
Generated WAL segment filenames remain byte-for-byte equivalent to the prior format! strings.
